tail.requestFormatError: The app sent an invalid request, so this reply could not be completed.
tail.replyFailed: This reply could not be completed. Check the error details for more information.
tail.interrupted: The app exited mid-task, so it was interrupted.
tail.executionResultUnavailable: Unable to retrieve the execution result. Automatic continuation has stopped. Ask the assistant to check the existing execution result.
tail.outputLimit: The model reached its output limit, so this response may be incomplete. Send the next message to continue.
tail.toolUseLoopDetected: The model repeated a tool call too many times, so Cindy stopped this turn to prevent an infinite loop. Send a new message to continue.
tail.toolUseLoopDetectedWithCount: The model kept repeating invalid tool calls, so Cindy stopped this turn after {{count}} failures to prevent an infinite loop. Send a new message to continue.
tail.toolUseLoopDetectedConsecutiveWithCount: The model repeated the same tool call {{count}} times, so Cindy stopped this turn to prevent an infinite loop. Send a new message to continue.
tail.toolUseLoopDetectedPingPongWithCount: The model kept cycling between tool calls, so Cindy stopped this turn after detecting {{count}} calls in the loop. Send a new message to continue.
tail.toolUseLoopDetectedRotationWithCount: The model kept rotating through tool calls, so Cindy stopped this turn after detecting {{count}} calls in the loop. Send a new message to continue.
tail.codexThreadLost: The Codex auth mode changed, so this session can't continue. Start a new session.
tail.encryptedContentInvalid: Switching providers made the encryption unavailable, so this session works only under the original provider. Handle it on the computer (use “Start new session from here” to drop the encrypted protocol content and continue in a new session).

outbox.deleteConfirmBody: This message wasn't sent. Deleting it can't be undone.
outbox.legacyPlanRecovery: This computer cannot restore saved messages in Plan mode. Turn off Plan mode or update Cindy on the computer, then retry.
outbox.creationRecoveryRequired: Retry creating this task before deleting its first message. That message keeps the recovery details for your later messages.
outbox.confirmationRequired: This computer cannot confirm whether the message was received. Check its history or update Cindy before retrying.
outbox.taskCleared: This task was cleared after you sent the message. The saved message has been kept for you to review.
outbox.restoreFailed: Saved messages could not be restored. They have not been deleted. Restart the app and try again.
outbox.recoveryTarget: Keep the original computer while recovering this task. Its later messages are still saved.
outbox.taskAlreadyCreated: This task already exists on the computer. Its saved messages will resume there.

remoteError.REMOTE_DAEMON_CLOSED: The remote connection dropped, possibly during an update. This turn has ended. Send the message again.
remoteError.REMOTE_LOCAL_ATTACHMENT_UNSUPPORTED: Local file/image attachments aren't accessible in remote sessions. Paste the content directly instead.
remoteError.AUTO_REVIEW_UNAVAILABLE: Auto approve could not reach a decision, so actions that need approval now need your confirmation. Switch this session to Full access if you would rather not be interrupted. That mode is higher risk.
remoteError.AUTO_REVIEW_UNAVAILABLE_WECHAT: Auto approve could not reach a decision, so actions that need approval now need your confirmation. Personal WeChat cannot use Full access. Confirm this action directly.
remoteError.AUTO_REVIEW_CONFIRM_UNDELIVERED: Auto approve was unavailable, and the confirmation request was not completed. This is not a user rejection.
remoteError.REMOTE_COMPAT_MODE_UNSUPPORTED: Remote tasks cannot use this computer’s compatibility route. Switch to Cindy AI, or continue in a local task.
remoteError.REMOTE_GATEWAY_ENDPOINT_UNAVAILABLE: Cindy AI credentials are not ready yet (issued automatically after sign-in). Try again shortly. If this persists, check the Cindy AI status in Settings → Model Providers.
remoteError.REMOTE_LOCAL_ONLY_PROVIDER: This model provider is a local-only service (e.g. Ollama) that a remote SSH task cannot reach. Switch to the Cindy AI gateway, or pick a provider reachable from the remote host.
remoteError.DEVICE_LINK_CONTROL_DISABLED: Control for this device is off; the message was not sent.
remoteError.DEVICE_LINK_BUSY: The remote computer is busy. Please try again shortly.
remoteError.DEVICE_LINK_MEDIA_TRANSFER_FAILED: Attachment transfer failed; the message was not sent. Please try again.
remoteError.MCP_APPROVAL_AUTO_BLOCKED: Auto approve blocked this tool call. No manual rejection was received.
remoteError.MCP_APPROVAL_CONFIRMATION_TIMEOUT: The permission request timed out without a confirmed decision. A timeout does not show whether you clicked a button.
remoteError.MCP_APPROVAL_CONFIRMATION_UNAVAILABLE: Permission confirmation could not be completed. No manual rejection was received.
remoteError.REMOTE_HOST_PROXY_FORWARD_UNAVAILABLE: This model needs this computer to forward requests, and the remote connection cannot do that yet. Switch to Cindy AI, or use this model in a local task.
remoteError.REMOTE_MODEL_SWITCH_ROUTE_CHANGE: Switching to this model needs a different connection. Start a new task to use it.
remoteError.REMOTE_NATIVE_OAUTH_UNAVAILABLE: Remote tasks cannot use a subscription sign-in yet. Switch to Cindy AI, or pick a provider with an API key.
remoteError.REMOTE_PI_CONTEXT_PROFILE_UNAVAILABLE: A remote Pi task cannot use this context profile. Switch to Cindy AI, or pick a model the remote computer can reach.
remoteError.REMOTE_PROVIDER_UNSUPPORTED: Remote tasks cannot use this model provider yet. Pick another provider, or use it in a local task.
remoteError.REMOTE_PROVIDER_UPDATING: This model provider’s credentials are updating. Try again in a moment.
remoteError.REMOTE_WORKDIR_UNAVAILABLE: The remote working directory is unavailable. Check that the folder still exists on that computer, then try again.
remoteError.REMOTE_OPTIMISTIC_SESSION_STATE_UNAVAILA: The computer cannot yet confirm whether this message was sent. Wait a moment and try again. Do not send the same message twice.
remoteError.REMOTE_AGENT_UNAVAILABLE: Can't reach the computer running the Agent. Make sure it's online and allows remote control, then try again.
remoteError.REMOTE_AGENT_PEER_TOO_OLD: Cindy on the other computer is too old to run the Agent for this one. Update Cindy there first.
remoteError.REMOTE_AGENT_EXPIRED: This session already ended on the computer running the Agent. Send your message again.
remoteError.REMOTE_AGENT_NOT_FOUND: This session already ended on the computer running the Agent. Send your message again.
remoteError.REMOTE_AGENT_BUSY: Too many sessions are running on the other computer. End some of them and try again.
remoteError.REMOTE_AGENT_UNSUPPORTED: This Agent isn't available on the other computer. Install or sign in to it there, or pick another Agent.
remoteError.REMOTE_AGENT_INVALID: Something went wrong talking to the computer running the Agent. Try again; if it keeps happening, update Cindy on both computers.
remoteError.REMOTE_AGENT_PROVIDER_NOT_ALLOWED: That computer hasn’t allowed remote use of this provider. On that computer, turn on “Allow remote use” in Settings → Providers, or pick another model.

collab.title: Collaboration
collab.roleHint: Just a name to tell collaborators apart. It doesn't change capabilities.
collab.customRolePredefinedError: A custom role name can't match a preset role
collab.modelDefaultHint: Uses the computer's default Worker model
collab.permissionAutoHint: Reads and writes inside the workspace and auto-reviews elevation requests. High-risk actions may be denied or need confirmation.
collab.permissionFullHint: Can change any file and run networked commands without asking again. Highest risk; use only for trusted tasks.
collab.initialTaskPlaceholder: An optional first task for this Worker
collab.hardLimitHint: Hard limit of {{limit}} reached · Archive a Worker to create more
collab.softLimitHint: Over the soft limit of {{limit}} · More Workers use more memory
collab.limitSummary: Soft limit {{soft}} Workers, hard limit {{hard}}. Change collaboration settings on your computer.
collab.stopConfirmDesc: Worker sessions will be destroyed. Any running task stops immediately and its results are lost. End collaboration?
collab.archiveConfirmDesc: This stops its session. History is kept as archived. Archived Workers can't be restored; create a new Worker to continue.
collab.disabledHint: Collaboration mode is off. Turn it back on in Settings on your computer.
collab.unavailableHint: Couldn't check collaboration settings. Try again later.
collab.startFailedContinue: Couldn't start collaboration. Continuing as a single task. {{reason}}

errors.unsupported: The computer's version is too old for collaboration
errors.WORKER_LIMIT_HARD_EXCEEDED: The Worker hard limit is reached. Archive a Worker first.
errors.NO_PROVIDER_FOR_AGENT: The computer has no model provider connected for this Agent. Connect one on the computer and try again.
errors.PROVIDER_ROUTE_UNAVAILABLE: The selected model and provider route isn't available on the computer. Choose an available model and try again.
errors.BUDGET_MODEL_REQUIRES_API_MODE: The computer hasn't set up the API key this Codex model needs. Set it up on the computer and try again.
errors.INVALID_PARAMS: The computer doesn't support the selected model or collaboration settings. Choose a supported model and try again.
errors.PRECONDITION_FAILED: Collaboration mode is off, or this task doesn't support collaboration.
errors.WORKER_CREATION_IN_PROGRESS: A Worker with the same name is being created. Try again shortly.
errors.WORKER_NOT_FOUND: This Worker no longer exists. The list was refreshed.
errors.ORCA_CREATE_UNCONFIRMED: Creating the Worker timed out and couldn't be confirmed. Check the Worker list first, and retry only if no new Worker appears.
errors.ORCA_ACTION_UNCONFIRMED: The request timed out, so the result isn't confirmed yet. The list has been refreshed; go by what it shows now.
